claims.claim: Duration estimates were more variable under dual-task load.
claims.quote: Variability of estimates increased under dual-task load, t(28) = 3.12, p = .004.

claims.claim: The load effect differed between blocks.
claims.quote: The load by block interaction was reliable, F(1, 56) = 6.35, p = .015.

claims.claim: The pattern agrees with an earlier attention-gating account.
claims.quote: This pattern is consistent with attention-gating accounts of timing [12].

claims.claim: An earlier study reported a slowdown of similar size.
claims.quote: A slowdown of similar size was reported previously [14].

claims.claim: The effect also appears in older adult samples.
claims.quote: The same effect has been shown in older adult samples [19].
